schema: FloraGPA streamed background API log acceptance 1

comparison.scope: Serial same-host original/synthetic captures; observed time/memory, not a general performance guarantee

limitations: Same-host relocated checks; not clean-host or renewed long-soak acceptance
Output text is streamed; per-command objects, cache and Query history still allocate
Cancellation cannot preempt a single decoder operation
Two-file publication can fail partially; diagnostic is explicit; no crash rollback
Other export, UI publication and recovery paths remain open
